Workflow.Name: Refresh Nightly Leaderboard Snapshot
Workflow.Description: Runs nightly at 02:00 America/Toronto to refresh the active season Best Seller, Top Poutine, and Best Supporter leaderboard snapshots in Dataverse. Replaces ranked entries idempotently and excludes Best Critic until the Review Quality agent is available.
